Policy Layer

The Policy Layer is the authoritative decision-making stage of the pipeline. It governs whether, when, and how a pipeline execution attempt is allowed to proceed, pause, retry, abort, or terminate, without deriving values or mutating state.

The Policy Layer is responsible for enforcing execution rules that span beyond individual behaviors, such as rate limiting, gating, retries, failure resolution, and external coordination. These decisions are applied deterministically and centrally, ensuring that pipeline execution remains safe, predictable, and serializable under all conditions.

Policy logic is implemented through Controllers, which are evaluated by the Decision Engine and enforced by the Conductor. Controllers do not perform work themselves; instead, they issue authoritative control decisions that determine how pipeline execution proceeds.

Policy Stage

The Policy Stage is responsible for evaluating and enforcing execution authority for each pipeline attempt. It represents the exclusive decision boundary where update attempts are allowed to proceed, paused, aborted, retried, or denied based on centralized policy evaluation.

The Policy Stage executes at well-defined points in the pipeline lifecycle—most notably during attempt admission and failure handling. It guarantees that every pipeline execution is governed by explicit, deterministic control decisions before work begins and after failures occur.

Policy controllers:

  • Operate exclusively on execution lifecycle signals, not values or state
  • Issue authoritative control decisions such as allow, pause, abort, or deny
  • Do not derive, transform, or inspect candidate state values
  • Do not mutate state or emit snapshots
  • Must preserve execution safety, determinism, and serial ordering

Core Execution Stage

The Policy stage is a core execution stage and is always present as part of the FeatureCell lifecycle. A core decision engine executes to coordinate and arbitrate all registered policy controllers. While the decision engine itself cannot be omitted, individual policy controllers are optional and participate in execution only when explicitly registered.

Policy controllers do not perform work, resume pipeline stages, or finalize outcomes themselves. Their responsibility is limited to issuing authoritative decisions that the Conductor enforces. Once a decision is resolved, pipeline execution proceeds—or terminates—according to that outcome.

Available Policy Controllers

The Policy Stage is a core execution stage and is always present as part of the FeatureCell lifecycle. A core decision engine executes to coordinate and arbitrate all policy decisions that govern pipeline execution.

Individual policy controllers are optional, add-on authorities that participate in the Policy stage only when explicitly registered. Each controller enforces a specific execution policy—such as timing, rate limiting, or external gating—without inspecting or modifying state values.

Policy controllers do not derive values, emit snapshots, or perform work. Their sole responsibility is to issue authoritative execution decisions that the Conductor enforces deterministically.
